sources.entry: R2Drop - Native macOS menu bar application for uploading files to Cloudflare R2 storage.

summary.one_liner: R2Drop is a native macOS app and companion CLI for uploading files and folders to Cloudflare R2 storage and getting back a shareable URL.
summary.what_it_does: R2Drop lets you upload to Cloudflare R2 from Finder (right-click "Send to R2"), by dragging files onto the menu bar or Dock icon, or through a file picker that accepts files and folders. A background queue tracks progress and supports retries and pause, resume, and cancel. It supports multiple accounts switchable from the menu bar, with per-account bucket and path-prefix routing. Uploads can auto-copy public URLs, including with a custom domain, and notifications report success, failure, and token expiry. A CLI (r2drop) provides login, upload, status, queue, accounts, history, and config commands, with JSON output for scripting. Deep links (r2drop://) are also supported for automation.
use_cases: upload files to Cloudflare R2 from Mac
share a file via public R2 URL
drag and drop uploads to cloud storage
manage multiple Cloudflare accounts and buckets
how_to_run: Download the latest .dmg from GitHub Releases and launch R2Drop
Complete onboarding: paste a Cloudflare API token and select a bucket
Install the CLI from the app via Settings → Install CLI (installs to /usr/local/bin), or use the quick install script
notable: Native Finder Sync right-click integration, menu bar, and Dock drop targets
Companion Rust CLI with JSON output for automation
Per-account bucket and path-prefix routing with custom domain URLs
Optional anonymous telemetry that can be fully disabled
Signed, notarized DMG releases via CI
caveats: Homebrew tap install is marked 'coming soon'
Finder right-click items can disappear due to aggressive Finder extension caching; the README suggests toggling the extension and running killall Finder
Requires a Cloudflare API token and an R2 bucket
